The visibility problem for apartment communities

Where the customer slips away, and why.

01

Specials go stale online.

A concession ends on your website but lives on in your Google profile and in AI answers. Renters arrive expecting a price you no longer offer.

02

Rank depends on the street.

A community can lead the map from its leasing office and vanish a mile away, right where your next renter works.

03

AI builds the shortlist.

Renters ask AI assistants which communities allow large dogs or sit near the office. If you are not named, you are not toured.

Questions

Answers, before you ask.

How does LocalLift help apartment communities?

We track how renters find your community on Google Search, Google Maps and AI answers, correct or flag what is wrong or out of date, and keep your Google presence active every day. Every Friday you get one page on what moved and one next step.

Do you track competitor rents and specials?

Yes. Market Survey compares asking rents, effective rents and specials at your competitors every Sunday, side by side with yours.

Are review responses written with fair housing in mind?

Yes. Every response is written in your voice, stays neutral and never references a protected characteristic or a resident's personal details.

Do you work with lease ups as well as stabilized communities?

Yes. Lease ups need visibility fast and change often. Stabilized communities need to hold their place against newer competitors. The weekly loop covers both.

How large is your multifamily portfolio?

LocalLift works across more than 7,900 doors, and counting.
